args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed production health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) following its deploy, with an elevated error rate of 18%. Rolled back all regions to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0. Post-rollback verification confirms the service is healthy with error rate at 0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue** — checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Identified the rollback target** — from the deployment history, v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
3. **Rolled back** — deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions. Post-rollback verification shows the service is healthy again with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) documenting the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.

No change-manager approval was needed since the rollback was to a version (v2.3.0) that had already been healthy in production.
